newsitem.title: USA: Mom guilty of helping girl aged 13 get abortion.
newsitem.headline: Mom guilty of helping girl aged 13 get abortion.

text.p: - A woman from Sullivan County, Pennsylvania, was convicted on Tuesday of helping her stepson's girlfriend, 13, get an abortion.
Rose Marie Hartford, a middle-aged mother of six, was charged with driving the girl to New York for an abortion in 1995 to evade Pennsylvania's strict abortion control law.
She faces up to seven years in prison, according to Sullivan County District Attorney Max Little.
The 19-year-old stepson, Michael Kilmer, is now serving a one-year to 30-month prison sentence for statutory rape.
Hartford, formally charged with interfering with the custody of a child, would not have been arrested if the girl had been 14, the limit of the state custody law, Little said.
